headword: {現状報告|げんじょうほうこく}
gloss: status report; progress report; current situation report

definitions.gloss: status report; progress report; current situation report
definitions.explanation: a report describing the present state of affairs, often used in business and project management

examples.japanese: {週|しゅう}に{一度|いちど}、{現状報告|げんじょうほうこく}をしてください。
examples.english: Please give a status report once a week.

examples.japanese: プロジェクトの{現状報告|げんじょうほうこく}を{資料|しりょう}にまとめた。
examples.english: I compiled a status report on the project into a document.

examples.japanese: {部長|ぶちょう}から{現状報告|げんじょうほうこく}を{求|もと}められたが、{進捗|しんちょく}が{思|おも}わしくなく、{報告|ほうこく}しにくかった。
examples.english: The department manager asked for a status report, but progress was poor and it was hard to report.

notes:
Composed of {現状|げんじょう} (current situation; status quo) + {報告|ほうこく} (report). A staple of Japanese business communication, especially in meetings, emails, and project updates.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {現状報告|げんじょうほうこく}をする: to give a status report
- {現状報告|げんじょうほうこく}を{求|もと}める: to request a status report
- {現状報告|げんじょうほうこく}を{受|う}ける: to receive a status report
- {現状報告|げんじょうほうこく}{書|しょ}: written status report

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {進捗報告|しんちょくほうこく}: progress report — focuses specifically on how much progress has been made toward a goal
- {中間報告|ちゅうかんほうこく}: interim report — a report given partway through a project or process
- {経過報告|けいかほうこく}: progress update — emphasizes the process and developments over time
